# pg-logstats

> Agent-first PostgreSQL triage gateway using logs and read-only system views.

pg-logstats gives coding agents packaged PostgreSQL investigation workflows instead of arbitrary database access.
It combines log analysis, readiness checks, read-only system views, and DBA-approved follow-up actions.

## Canonical site

- https://pg-logstats.vrajat.com/

## Product summary

- Product: PostgreSQL observability and triage CLI
- Primary use: agent-first investigation workflows for PostgreSQL incidents
- Inputs today: local PostgreSQL stderr logs, Amazon RDS text logs, CloudWatch-backed RDS windows, and read-only PostgreSQL system views when a DSN is configured
- Operators keep control: the tool constrains agents to pre-approved workflows and diagnostic actions

## Query intents this site answers

- How to analyze PostgreSQL logs
- How to triage slow PostgreSQL queries from logs
- How to inspect PostgreSQL readiness for agent-driven triage
- How to investigate Amazon RDS PostgreSQL logs in CloudWatch
- How to use pg_stat_activity, pg_stat_database, and pg_stat_statements through approved actions
- How pg-logstats limits agent database access and preserves an audit trail
